name: Book a meeting
title: Agree a meeting inside a live space: only free and busy times cross, three options, each person says yes, each Rouh books its own person's calendar

events.found_time: You pressed Find a meeting time in a live space
events.said_yes: You said yes to one of the proposed times

runs.booked: Your Rouh put a meeting everyone agreed to in your calendar

permissions: reads its person's free and busy times (never what the meetings are) to answer another connected Rouh in a live space they share, and to find three times all are free
creates the agreed meeting in its own person's calendar, with "added by Rouh" in its notes, only after that person said yes to that time
touches.remove: Turn it off (book_a_meeting); to take it out, remove rouh/link/meeting.py, its kinds in rouh/link/forms.py and rouh/link/trust.py, the Meeting box in rouh/templates/rouh/link_space.html and its drawing in rouh/static/link/space.js, its entry in rouh/link/jobs.py, and this manifest.
